_comment: Settings → General hero card. Edited here and fetched by the app at runtime, so plan copy and sponsors change WITHOUT shipping a build. Data only — every field renders as escaped text, never as markup. Unknown fields are ignored; anything malformed falls back to the app's built-in defaults. URLs must be https.
